items.title: DefiLlama delayed mobile launch over phishing apps on Apple Store, founder says
items.snippet: DefiLlama’s founder said Apple removed one fake app within days after the company documented it draining funds from a small crypto wallet.
items.note: Позитивний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами.

items.title: The 'long bitcoin, short the bankers' era is officially over as TradFi giants embrace digital assets
items.snippet: Financial firms are partnering with specialists to build infrastructure, blurring lines between traditional and decentralized finance into a unified sector.
